questions.topic: Expected revenue with three bidders
questions.stem: Expected revenue with 3 bidders uniform [0,1]?
questions.explanation: 2/4=0.5. Confirms earlier results. Expected revenue follows from the distribution of the relevant order statistic among three bidders. Using the mean value instead of an order statistic is the typical error.

questions.subject: MICROECONOMICS
questions.topic: The first-price bid with four bidders
questions.stem: Four bidders draw values uniformly from zero to one in a first-price auction. What is expected revenue?
questions.explanation: 3/5=0.6. Matches second-price by revenue equivalence. With four bidders the optimal first-price bid shades below value because winning requires the highest of four draws. Bidding the full value ignores the shading incentive and is the common error.
